title: The Last Garden
author: Astrid Dravenmoor
blurb: Rosalind Dunmore, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
